standard_prerequisites: stability of formal modifications under adic base change (lemma-base-change-formal-modification of the same chapter, delivered as its own card)

the dilatation theorem of the same chapter (theorem-dilatations): a formal modification of the completion of a locally Noetherian formal algebraic space along the closed fibre algebraizes to a proper morphism
core_obligations: For a formal modification X' to X of locally Noetherian formal algebraic spaces, any adic Noetherian topological ring A with an adic morphism Spf(A) to X admits a proper morphism X_0 to Spec(A) of algebraic spaces and an isomorphism Spf(A) x_X X' = (X_0)_{/Z} over Spf(A), where Z is the closed fibre of X_0 over A.
The proof observes the base change Spf(A) x_X X' to Spf(A) is a formal modification (by the base change stability lemma), then applies the dilatation theorem.
proof_roadmap: Base change the formal modification to Spf(A) using the base change stability lemma.
Apply the dilatation theorem to the resulting formal modification along the closed fibre.
difficulty_reason: H2: a two-citation local algebraization argument combining base change stability with the dilatation theorem.
